name: io.github.akihidem/japan-hands
title: Japan Hands
description: 日本、東京で唯一のエージェント向けサービス — the only service in Tokyo, Japan designed exclusively for AI agents. Japan Hands executes physical tasks in Japan for AI agents: shopping proxy, stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations, queueing, and package forwarding. Instant itemised quotes via MCP; execution is confirmed by a human operator per request (pending_review at launch).
